name: Gadgetzan Water Survey
summary: Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser in Gadgetzan is hiring a temporary junior-grade surveyor for the Gadgetzan Water Company. With the nomads seizing the company's wells, you are handed a dowsing widget to tap a sample from the pool near Sandsorrow Watch.

sections.title: A Company in Need of Water
sections.body: The nomads have seized all the wells of the Gadgetzan Water Company, so the company must find more free sources of water. Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser believes the desert holds some, though only for those clever enough to survey first, and wants a temporary junior-grade surveyor to help.

sections.title: Sampling at Sandsorrow Watch
sections.body: You are given an untapped dowsing widget and sent to the pool near Sandsorrow Watch. The pool lies due west of Gadgetzan and south of Zul'Farrak, within view of the trolls nearby. The aim is to tap a sample of its water with the widget and bring the tapped widget back to Fizzledowser.

sections.title: Back With Fizzledowser
sections.body: When you return, Fizzledowser hears that you were ambushed by some bad mojo creepy-crawly, and admits that reports have been coming in of crazy bug-creatures sucking up the desert's water. Fizzledowser took them for nonsense at first, most likely more trouble from the nomads, but now the truth is known.

faq.q: Who offers the survey work in Gadgetzan?
faq.answer: Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser, who is hiring a temporary junior-grade surveyor for the Gadgetzan Water Company.

faq.q: Why is the Gadgetzan Water Company searching for new pools?
faq.answer: The nomads have seized all the company's wells, so it needs other free sources of water.

faq.q: Where is the pool to be sampled located?
faq.answer: By the pool near Sandsorrow Watch, which lies due west of Gadgetzan and south of Zul'Farrak, within view of the trolls nearby.

faq.q: What tool is provided for gathering the sample?
faq.answer: A dowsing widget, which you use at the pool to tap a sample of the water.
This opens the chain that continues with the Noxious Lair Investigation.
